title: Oracle: TIMESTAMP WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE lands as text with the zone name inside

found.by: 2026-10-26 test round: Oracle Free 23.26.3, standard gateway, one run

symptom: TIMESTAMP(9) WITH LOCAL TIME ZONE 12:00:00.123456789 in a +00:00 session arrives as the string '2026-10-25 12:00:00 Etc/UTC.123456789'. TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE in the same run arrived as a timestamp in UTC.
cause: Not established: the zone name is written inside the text.
effect: The value isn't a timestamp; downstream parsing has to drop the zone name first.
fix: Parse the text downstream (not tested). Or use TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE on the source (not tested).
